scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev --skip-generate
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.full-stack: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup && npm run dev:all
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,ADMIN,STORE" --prefix-colors "green,cyan,blue" "npm run backend" "npm run admin" "npm run dev"
